verdict.rationale: Manufact is primarily a deploy/observability/testing platform for your own MCP servers, but one changelog entry mentions a public 'mcp-catalog' page where users can browse public checklist scores for MCP URLs, hinting at some catalog/discovery surface. There's no evidence of searching or browsing by capability, nor of a large curated catalog of third-party tools to wire into an agent. Missing for 10: search-by-capability functionality, scale/breadth of the catalog, and any independent confirmation of the catalog's usefulness for discovery.
